paragraphs.text: Odyssey has four bicolored theme decks .
Liftoff is a mid-range white / blue theme deck with a threshold theme.
The rares in this deck are Cephalid Retainer and Mystic Crusader .
One-Two Punch is an aggro red / green theme deck with a focus on flashback and creature tokens.
The rares in this deck are Nantuko Mentor and Seize the Day .
Pressure Cooker is a mid-range black / red theme deck with a threshold theme.
The rares in this deck are Braids, Cabal Minion and Repentant Vampire .
Trounce-O-Matic is a mid-range green / blue theme deck with a threshold theme.
The rares in this deck are Ivy Elemental and Stone-Tongue Basilisk .
